entries.title: Life above the waters
entries.description: A low coastal viewpoint with clear shallows filling the left foreground; several living fish visible beneath rippled water and a small uneven flight of seabirds lifting across the right sky. Rich true daylight, intricate feathers, wet stones and plants. No person, no silhouette of Christ, no beams forming a divine hand. The concrete subjects are the waters, living creatures and birds named in Genesis. Avoid the existing generic creation sunrise and star-field compositions: motion of wings and life within water are the central action. Do not imply a photographed primordial location or scientific chronology.
entries.caption: Birds move above the water while life stirs beneath its surface. Genesis invites us to recognize the life of the world as God’s creation.
entries.caption_caveat: An illustration of the living creatures described in Genesis, not a reconstructed photograph of creation.
entries.alt: Birds lift above a rocky shore while fish move beneath clear shallow water.
entries.uniqueness_rationale: Distinct from existing dawn/stars originals: specific moving creatures and waters in Genesis 1:20–23, not another empty sunrise.

entries.title: He sees the finger of the Lord
entries.description: A source-specific first stage of Ether 3:6, before the full revelation: the same brother of Jared recoils in reverent fear on the mountainside as a single natural humanlike finger extends through a softly luminous atmospheric veil toward one of the prepared stones. Show only the finger and the minimum adjoining hand needed for coherent anatomy; the Lord's face, head, torso and full body remain entirely unseen. Use sixteen distinct clear stones if the whole group is visible; do not add extra stones. Only a stone already touched may shine with restrained light. Do not depict a fully revealed Christ simultaneously touching the stones. The brother of Jared's own hands must be clearly separate and visibly not the hand touching the stones. Cloudlike atmosphere is an artistic treatment informed by Ether 2:4,14, not a claim that Ether 3:6 describes a literal cloud. Photographic natural human skin and anatomy, reverent fear without horror, no nail scars, no blood, no halo or theatrical giant hand.
entries.caption: The brother of Jared sees the Lord's finger as the stones are touched, and he falls in fear. When asked whether he has seen more, he answers that he has not and asks the Lord to show Himself.
entries.caption_caveat: The visible finger follows Ether 3:6-10. Cloudlike atmosphere is interpretive; the full revelation of the Lord comes afterward.
entries.alt: The brother of Jared reacts in awe as a finger emerges from a veil of light toward a stone.
entries.uniqueness_rationale: New intermediate story event between preparing the stones and the later full revelation; no reused artwork, pose change or second owner for the existing reveal.
